subject: The 3AM save that saved her startup
preview_text: How one founder used Smart Notes to turn a crisis into clarity — and how you can too.
body_paragraphs: Sarah was drowning. Her co-founder quit at midnight, and the investor call was in 8 hours. She had 47 Slack messages, a half-baked pitch, and zero memory of the last 3 meetings that mattered. Sound familiar?

She opened Smart Notes on instinct — and found a transcript from that Tuesday 2PM strategy call she'd forgotten. The AI summary pulled out 3 key objections the investor would raise, plus a list of action items she'd never written down. She had her pitch ready by 5AM.

That's the thing about this app — it doesn't just record. It finds what you missed. Your own meeting history is a goldmine of forgotten insights, buried under chaos. One tap, and you get the clarity you thought you lost.
Open the app now and search for any meeting from last week. I bet you'll find something you forgot that matters. P.S. Sarah closed that round — and she still uses Smart Notes every day.
